business_summary: Allmed Medical Products Co.,Ltd supplier in medical dressings and infection control solutions in China and internationally. The company offers traditional wound care products include nonwoven and woven gauze swabs, non-adherent pads, drain sponges, abdominal pads, fluffy sponges/bandages, woven gauze and nonwoven gauze balls, eye pads, cotton filled exodontia sponges, packing strips, ribbon gauze, cotton tipped applicators, elastic net bandages, nose bandages, instrument covers, impregnated gauze dressings, adhesive dressings and tapes, wound bandages, kits, and precut gamgee. It also provides advanced wound care products consist of hydrocolloid dressings, hydrocolloid bandages, blister dressings, silicone foam dressings, superabsorbent dressings, silicone scar patches, and alginate dressings; OR consumables, include x-ray woven gauze/nonwoven gauze swabs and balls, neuro and laparotomy sponges, OR towels, and disposable towel drapes. In addition, the company offers infection products, such as SMS fabric, sterilization wraps, surgical gowns, drapes, surgical packs, normal isolation gowns, isolation gowns (various levels), masks, surgical caps, shoe covers, and boot covers. Allmed Medical Products Co.,Ltd was founded in 1997 and is based in Zhijiang, the People's Republic of China.
